title: LEDGE: An Efficient Simulator for Distributed LLM Serving on Heterogeneous Edge Devices
abstract: arXiv:2611.24085v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating distributed large language model (LLM) serving on heterogeneous edge devices requires exploring diverse model partitions, device placements, and network conditions, making repeated physical experiments costly. An efficient simulator for edge LLM serving must support diverse, fine-grained placement configurations, capture runtime behavior, and accurately predict execution times while keeping simulation overhead low. We present LEDGE, a lightweight simulator for fast, fine-grained evaluation of distributed LLM serving on heterogeneous edge devices without executing tensor operations. LEDGE constructs event graphs supporting non-uniform tensor and pipeline parallelism, estimates execution costs using reusable performance models calibrated from end-to-end measurements, and simulates shared-link contention. We evaluate LEDGE on a heterogeneous testbed of 10 Jetson and Raspberry Pi devices, covering 17 model--precision combination

translated_title: LEDGE：一种用于异构边缘设备上分布式大语言模型服务的高效模拟器
translated_abstract: 在异构边缘设备上评估分布式大语言模型（LLM）服务需要探索多样的模型划分方式、设备部署方案和网络条件，这使得反复进行物理实验的成本非常高昂。一个高效的边缘LLM服务模拟器必须支持多样化、细粒度的部署配置，捕捉运行时行为，并在保持较低模拟开销的同时准确预测执行时间。我们提出了LEDGE，这是一个轻量级模拟器，无需执行张量运算即可对异构边缘设备上的分布式LLM服务进行快速、细粒度的评估。LEDGE构建事件图以支持非均匀的张量并行和流水线并行，利用通过端到端测量校准的可复用性能模型来估计执行成本，并模拟共享链路上的竞争。我们在由10台Jetson和Raspberry Pi设备组成的异构测试平台上对LEDGE进行了评估，涵盖17种模型-精度组合……
tldr: 提出了LEDGE，一个无需执行张量运算即可对异构边缘设备上的分布式LLM服务进行快速、细粒度评估的轻量级模拟器，支持非均匀张量与流水线并行、性能模型校准和共享链路竞争模拟。
